item.title: Kaga Cuisine & Kaiseki Ryori: Kanazawa's Refined Multi-Course Dining — Guide
item.description: Kaga cuisine developed under the patronage of the wealthy Maeda clan, whose resources allowed Kanazawa’s culinary traditions to flourish alongside the region’s abundant seafood, Kaga vegetables and rice, resulting in a refined local cooking style closely associated with kaiseki ryori, Japan’s traditional multi-course haute cuisine. A full kaiseki meal typically progresses through a sequence of small, carefully composed courses, from appetisers and sashimi through grilled and simmered dishes to rice and dessert, each plated with attention to seasonal presentation.
